approved.reasoning: Correction against CE5-SA's order of 2 unit for RM 210 dated 2026-09-27 (s210). Sets assoc from unset to CE5-SA, stream from unset to R2. It moves the row from CE5-SA to CE5-SA-R, the associate's resale account, where an R2 books since v611. It moves no cash and no stock: it changes what the row says about itself. The row is not rewritten here. The fold applies the patch, so there is one definition of what a correction does rather than two.
